name: Mew Advanced Deck Building Gift Box

releases.name: Mew Advanced Deck Building Gift Box

description.text: The Fusion Strike Deck Building Advanced Gift Box (汇流卡组构筑进阶礼盒) came out on 12 July 2024 as a way into Fusion Strike decks. It held Mew V in new artwork, Genesect V and Oricorio, 24 Trainer cards and three Special Energy for a Fusion Strike deck, among them Elesa's Sparkle, Power Tablet, Double Turbo Energy and Fusion Strike Energy, and ten of each of the eight basic Energy. With them came Mew-themed damage-counter dice, a coin die, a damage-counter box and a card box, a second Radiant Energy theme pack and six 25-card Nine Colours Gathering Origin packs.
